bias.en: Downtrend · broke $130, lowest close since April
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $130，收盘创 4月以来新低

read.en: Marvell fell 11.7% on Nov 20 to $122.28, its lowest close since Apr 9, trading $120.56–134.18. It is below the 5-day ($140.1), 10-day ($149.9), 30-day ($194.8) and 100-day ($218.6), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($188.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($156.76), and RSI is 27.9, oversold.
read.zh: 迈威尔 11月20日下跌 11.7%，收于 $122.28，为 4月9日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $120.56–134.18。股价位于 5 日（$140.1）、10 日（$149.9）、30 日（$194.8）和 100 日均线（$218.6）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$188.6）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$156.76），RSI 为 27.9，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $130–135.3 (Nov 5 and 6 lows, round number), now resistance. Resistance is $123.4–127.5 (early-2025 highs), then $128.4–133.6 (Apr 16 low, Nov 5 low and close) and $138.4 (Nov 19 close). Support is $119.9–121.8 (Nov 20 low, Apr 9 close), then $116.5 and $109.8–111.6. A close above $127.5 would target $128.4–133.6; below $119.9, $116.5.

r.en: Apr 16 low $128.42; round number $130, lost; Nov 5 low $132.54 and close $133.55
